title: RSA SETKEY imports key to device but RSA PK always returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE
description: With WOLF_CRYPTO_CB_SETKEY enabled, wc_RsaSetKey on a crypto2dev-bound key calls crypto2dev_setkey which opens a device fd, imports the DER to hardware, and stores the fd in key->devCtx. But crypto2dev_rsa() always returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE so RSA operations use software with the wolfSSL key struct. The device fd stored in devCtx is never used for any crypto operation; it just sits open until the key is freed. Consequence per RSA key: one wasted open fd and one wasted DER import ioctl, for zero benefit. A future maintainer or contributor will see key->devCtx set and assume RSA hardware is working. Should either skip RSA SETKEY (return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE) or document explicitly that SETKEY succeeds so the fd is pre-positioned for future RSA implementation.
